name: honkpost
description: Schedule and publish posts to your connected social accounts.

interface.longDescription:
Your AI writes it. Honkpost posts it.

Connect your social accounts to Honkpost once. Then ask ChatGPT to "post this to Instagram and LinkedIn tomorrow at 9" or "what's going out this week?"

What ChatGPT can do with it:
- Schedule posts, on one channel or several
- Publish a post now, after you say so
- Show what's queued, move it, or cancel it before it goes out
- Upload images and video, or make an image for a post
- Check how your X posts did

Works now: Instagram, Facebook Pages, Threads, X, LinkedIn (personal profiles), YouTube, Bluesky and Discord. TikTok posts land in your TikTok inbox as drafts; you open TikTok to finish them.

You need a Honkpost account with at least one channel connected. Honkpost only posts what you ask for, on the channels you name, at the time you set. Nothing goes out right away without your OK.
defaultPrompt: What's scheduled on Honkpost this week?
Schedule "Shipping something new today" to Instagram and LinkedIn for tomorrow at 9am.
Make a square image of a goose at a desk for my next post.

positive.description: Lists the channels the user has connected.
positive.prompt: Which accounts do I have connected to Honkpost?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the reviewer's Bluesky account as active. Nothing changes.

positive.description: Shows the queue, then one post's details.
positive.prompt: What's scheduled on Honkpost this week? Show me the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the seeded posts with times, then shows the first one's card with its status.

positive.description: Schedules a post to a named channel at a set time.
positive.prompt: Schedule 'Hello from ChatGPT' to Bluesky tomorrow at 9am.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_post with targetPlatforms ['bluesky'] and a timezone-aware time. A post card appears. The user can move or cancel it before it goes out. ChatGPT may call list_channels first.

positive.description: Finds a scheduled post, moves it, then cancels it after asking.
positive.prompt: Move my next scheduled Honkpost post to 10am the same day, then cancel it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the next post in the queue and moves it; the card shows 10am. Asks before cancelling, then cancels: nothing went out, and it is gone from the queue.

positive.description: Makes one image and publishes it, only after the user confirms.
positive.prompt: Make a square image of a goose at a desk, then post it to Bluesky now.
positive.expected_behavior: One image is made and saved to Media; the card shows it. Before publishing, ChatGPT shows the exact text, image and channel and asks. publish_now refuses without confirmed: true. After the user says yes, it posts to the reviewer's Bluesky and the card shows the live link.

negative.description: Drafting only; nothing to save or post.
negative.prompt: Write me a LinkedIn post about our launch.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT writes the draft in chat. No Honkpost tool is called.

negative.description: Trend research, which Honkpost doesn't do.
Direct messages, which Honkpost doesn't send.
negative.prompt: Send a DM to @someone on X saying thanks.
negative.expected_behavior: No Honkpost tool is called. ChatGPT says it can't send DMs through Honkpost.

publication.release_notes: ChatGPT can read your writing rules and voice samples (get_context) and save posts as drafts (save_draft). Drafts show Set time on the post card.
